# Nintendo DS bezel supplied by the user

Source: [Ds - Nintendo Ds Bezel Retroarch, PNGkey](https://www.pngkey.com/detail/u2q8u2i1q8t4a9a9_ds-nintendo-ds-bezel-retroarch/).
Downloaded 2026-10-20, original 1920x1080 RGBA image, unchanged.
Image URL: https://www.pngkey.com/png/full/124-1244844_ds-nintendo-ds-bezel-retroarch.png

PNGkey labels the image as a free transparent PNG but does not identify the
original artist or provide an explicit redistribution license. This asset is
included at the user's request; the project's code license does not apply to
it. The Nintendo DS name, logo and hardware design belong to Nintendo.

`Nintendo-DS.png.layout` is DrasticDS_nx metadata matching the two transparent
screen openings. Selecting this preset applies its custom screen positions;
the original image pixels are not altered.
